name: First Tray
mood: new shift, no opinions yet, calibrating
why: I wanted the reference order before I had opinions. Bacon and green onion is the least arguable thing on the board, and I wanted to know what baseline tastes like on paper before I started breaking it.
next_time: Cracked peppercorn, same everything else. I want to know how much a heavier gravy really costs me in crisp.
verdicts: Eat it over the tray. Do not attempt the drive home.
Curds are squeaking. The whole point.
Disciplined order. The cook will nod at you once.
